Subject: Planning the EB briefing — timelines & decision criteria

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency benchmarks and the model routing scenarios. We need to put together a short MAP for our internal exec board and lock an EB (executive briefing) slot before the end of November.

Immediate asks from my side:
- Can you share a 1-page MAP with milestones and what decisions are expected at each step?
- What dates do you have available for an EB in the week of Nov 15–19? Our CEO prefers morning slots (PST).
- We will need a decision criteria checklist to present to our CIO — can you send a short doc?

Attached: draft procurement questionnaire (we started).

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Romero
Director, Strategic Programs
Nova Product Co.

Subject: Re: Planning the EB briefing — timelines & decision criteria

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear asks. I put together an initial mutual action plan and a one‑page for the CIO decision checklist. See the attached MAP draft and executive brief.

Quick answers:
- MAP includes milestones for pilot (data ingest), performance validation, compliance review, and procurement sign-off — with owner names and estimated durations.
- For EB, we have open morning slots on Nov 16 and Nov 18 between 9–11am PST. We can reserve a 45–60 minute slot and include a 15-minute Q&A with the CTO.
- Decision checklist is the one‑pager labeled 'CIO Decision Criteria' in the exec brief.

Next step: I recommend a 30-minute pre-EB alignment call with your CIO and our head of product (Marissa) to walk through the decision criteria and the MAP owners. Are you able to do that the week of Oct 19?

I copied Marissa and Karthik to help with timelines and technical validation items.

Thanks — attaching: Nova_MAP_v1.2.xlsx, redwood_exec_brief_v0.9.pdf

—
Monica Patel

Monica

Alicia — confirmed. Thank you.

1) EB is confirmed for Nov 16, 09:30–10:30 PST. Run-of-show and final slide pack (15-minute exec brief + appendix) are here: https://drive.redwood.ai/board-briefs/NV-0893 (link).

2) Pre-EB alignment call: Oct 26, 10:00–10:30 PST — invite sent to CIO and our product/tech leads. Agenda: review decision checklist, confirm validation datasets & acceptance criteria, procurement redlines.

3) Audit logs: we support exporting audit logs to an S3 bucket. Per your retention ask we can stage a configuration for 90-day retention; Karthik will follow up with the S3 IAM scope and the sample export script.

4) Performance validation checklist: Karthik attached a one-page validation plan to the invite and uploaded synthetic load harness to the shared drive folder.

5) Procurement: Monica will collect the redlines and prepare a short summary to speed the approval cycle (DocuSign link to be sent once term sheet language is agreed).

Looking forward — we'll be ready for the EB run-through on Oct 26.

—
Monica Patel
